purpose: Add an app-owned mapped-candidate same-input gate packet builder that turns an accepted clean workload mapping and materialized candidate files into author hd_exec and RTDL hd_exec-compatible command plans for a later POD gate.

inputs: Goal5338 candidate workload mapping review JSON
author hd_exec path or command name

behavior_locked_by_tests: accepted mapping plus materialized files builds author and RTDL command plans
accepted mapping without materialized files is not POD-ready

pod_usage.reason: This goal builds a command packet only. A later mapped same-input POD gate must execute the commands with scripts/current_pod_ssh.py after real accepted mapping and staged files exist.

allowed_summary: Goal5339 adds an app-owned command-packet builder for a future mapped-candidate same-input POD gate. It does not execute commands and does not claim reproduction.
not_allowed: claiming commands were executed by this packet
claiming same-input correctness from this packet alone
claiming exact paper dataset reproduction from this packet alone
claiming Figure 5 reproduction from this packet alone
claiming full X-HD paper reproduction from this packet alone
claiming author-vs-RTDL performance ratio from this packet alone
